name: nmr-walkthrough
description: Build click-to-advance, bilingual NMR structure-solving walkthroughs from real, sourced data.
long_description: Turns a solved NMR structure problem into one self-contained HTML page: spectra drawn from the peak list with zoom and highlighting, 2D maps (COSY, HSQC, HMBC, NOESY), a structure that grows step by step, a running assignment table, read-aloud and a full transcript, in 中文 and English. Every value must come from the user's spectra or a cited source; specs without sources are rejected. Pages are written to ~/nmr-walkthroughs unless NMR_WALKTHROUGH_DIR is set.

tools.name: nmr_walkthrough_guide
tools.description: Teaching method, spec schema and a complete example

tools.name: validate_nmr_walkthrough
tools.description: Check a walkthrough spec (missing sources, unassigned peaks, ...)

tools.name: build_nmr_walkthrough
tools.description: Build the walkthrough as one self-contained HTML page
